sources.entry: funes by David Corvoysier - Durable cross-agent memory for Claude Code, Codex, pi, and Hermes. Your memory is a Hugging Face dataset you own: recall it from any machine or share it with your team. Single binary, local index, pinned local embedding models.

summary.one_liner: funes is a Rust CLI that indexes past sessions from Claude Code, Codex, pi, and Hermes into a local, searchable memory that can be published to and recalled from a Hugging Face dataset.
summary.what_it_does: funes indexes transcripts from Claude Code, Codex, pi, and Hermes into one local memory, with each hit labeled by its source agent. Recall fuses vector and BM25 search and reranks candidates using pinned local embedding and reranking models; it does not include a generative model of its own. The `funes get` command reassembles a cited turn in full, and `funes sessions`, `sketch`, and `scan` browse sessions. A memory can be published to a Hugging Face dataset repo (private by default) with `funes push`, and read from with `--memory`, including other people's public memories. A `funes ask` command hands a question to an installed agent to produce a grounded answer that names its sources. Secrets are redacted at index time and a push gate refuses chunks that still contain secrets.
use_cases: give a coding agent recall of earlier decisions and rationale
search past Claude Code or Codex sessions
share a project's agent memory with teammates via the Hugging Face Hub
move context between agents and machines
query someone else's published memory on a topic
get a grounded answer about past work with citations to sessions
how_to_run: curl -fsSL " | sh  (installer; the URL in the README is truncated)
funes add claude  (or codex, pi, hermes)
funes recall "why is funes append-only" --memory huggingface/funes-memory
funes ask claude "why is funes append-only" --memory huggingface/funes-memory
funes push /funes-memory  (publish local memory to the Hub)
cargo build --release  (from source; requires Rust toolchain and protoc)
notable: Memory is a Hugging Face dataset you own; publish it and recall from any machine or teammate with one flag
One memory spans Claude Code, Codex, pi, and Hermes, and each hit shows its source agent
Pinned local embedding and reranking models; no generative model bundled, so the reasoning model can change freely
Dataset repos created by funes are private by default, with a secrets-redaction and always-on push gate
Single prebuilt binary for Linux x86_64, Linux aarch64, and macOS Apple Silicon, with checksum verification
caveats: Prebuilt binaries cover only Linux x86_64, Linux aarch64, and macOS Apple Silicon; other platforms need building from source
Building from source requires a Rust toolchain and protoc; the integration test downloads model weights on first run
Each memory holds one embedding model's vectors; changing the model means rebuilding the memory from transcripts
The checksum does not authenticate the release bucket itself, per the README
